policy.claim_boundary: Retained research claims remain bounded evidence and do not authorize parser or status change.
policy.route_boundary: All 13 follow-ups have a durable owner and terminal routing state; open dependencies are not treated as completed research.
policy.native_panel_boundary: Native-speaker work follows direct research and contextual corpus evidence only when a precise item-level question remains.
policy.numeral_route_reconciliation: The original off-by-one ID range remains locked as provenance; the exact ten 億 source rows are resolved separately.

claims.claim: The clarification examples instantiate several discourse tasks—open repair initiation, repetition request, referent clarification, and meaning clarification—not one surface construction.
claims.boundary: General repair theory classifies interactional jobs but does not validate 咩話, 再講多次, or the source register labels as ordinary Cantonese formulas.

claims.claim: 咩話？ is a source-attested repair initiator and must remain distinct from productive wh-question and sentence-final me1 analyses.
claims.boundary: The orthographic form 咩 does not by itself identify clause syntax, rhetorical force, or a sentence-final-particle use.

claims.claim: 你講嘅係邊個 contains an overt 嘅 nominalized or omitted-head constituent plus an identity question; the omitted material and referent set are context-dependent.
claims.boundary: Do not treat 嘅 as merely a sentence-final particle or invent the omitted noun.

claims.claim: The turn-management examples differ in interruption, floor-holding, apology, imperative, completion, sequencing, and confirmation/request force.
claims.boundary: No formula, politeness level, or productive 等 + NP + VP analysis is accepted without direct Cantonese discourse evidence and speaker review.

claims.claim: 講完 contains an overt V + 完 completion relation, but the entire 唔該等我講完先好唔好 sequence is not one completion construction.
claims.boundary: Completion, permissive or floor-holding 等, sequencing 先, and 好唔好 request force require independent profiles.

claims.claim: 你食咗飯未 is a completion-oriented polar question with postverbal perfective material and final 未; it is not a preverbal 未 negative statement or an A-not-A exact-copy question.
claims.boundary: The exact V咗O未 profile still needs direct modern Cantonese research and contextual contrasts before any parser change.

claims.claim: 我要返屋企煮飯 and 我去超市買嘢 contain overt destination motion followed by a semantically compatible purpose VP.
claims.boundary: Destination motion and purpose relation remain independently parsed; adjacency does not license every two-verb sequence.

claims.claim: 我留喺屋企睇電視 contains a locative relation with a following predicate and must not be collapsed with a standalone 喺 + location predicate.
claims.boundary: The lexical contribution of 留, event location, and the following activity predicate remain visible.

claims.claim: 幫你買嘢 is source-attested as a participant-benefiting relation, but the lesson alone does not determine whether 幫 is lexical, coverbal, applicative, or part of another construction.
claims.boundary: Do not infer a benefactive role solely from token presence or create a broad 幫 + NP + VP rule.

claims.claim: 返嚟 preserves return direction and speaker-oriented deixis; it must not be reduced to a generic serial-verb or aspect marker.
claims.boundary: The full 咁我幫你買嘢返嚟啦 sequence additionally contains discourse, participant, object, and particle structure.

claims.claim: The 25 common-verb rows are lexical attestations, not complete valency frames; several forms have motion, directional, coverb, aspectual, posture, light-verb, or reading collisions.
claims.boundary: Twenty-four exact modular entries block duplicate bulk ingress; 著 requires separate lexical and pronunciation review rather than silent addition.

claims.claim: The temporal vocabulary spans time-of-day nouns, measure expressions, event and calendar nouns, relative time words, scalar temporal properties, periodicity modifiers, and temporal adverbs.
claims.boundary: Adverbial use does not make every item a lexical adverb, and lexical category does not determine one clause role.

claims.claim: 黎明, 午夜, 正午, 世紀, 季度, 時代, 刹那, 日程, and 截止日期 require register, frequency, and A1-appropriateness review rather than automatic runtime ingress.
claims.boundary: Formal or written appearance is a review hypothesis, not a categorical rejection or dialect-wide judgment.

claims.claim: 一億 through 十億 are compositional numeral expressions; no ten-item opaque lexical expansion is justified.
claims.boundary: Preserve internal numeral composition and avoid duplicate whole-form entries.

claims.claim: The source particle table's one-gloss-per-character mapping is not a complete Cantonese particle grammar.
claims.boundary: Tone, clause type, discourse context, co-occurrence, prosody, orthography, and non-final uses must remain explicit; 嘅 nominalization is not erased.

claims.claim: The phonics table is provisional source material and includes an incomplete 香 / — row; its heading does not transparently describe every listed pair.
claims.boundary: No IPA, Jyutping, pronunciation-resource, or pair-status change is authorized without item-level verification.

non_candidate_routes.resolution_basis: The ledger describes ten 億 expressions; exact source surfaces are I062–I071, while I061 is 截止日期.
non_candidate_routes.reason: All ten 億 forms remain compositionally analyzable; no opaque bulk lexical entries are warranted.
